# Source code and analysis scripts for Cheung _et al_., 2026

Jupyter notebooks and python scripts for the analyses presented in the manuscript "Β2AR Agonists Sustain Thermogenesis and Leanness via Sympathofacilitation", by Samson W. Cheung and colleagues. 


These notebooks analyse two separate datasets:

* Sympathetic ganglia: a meta-analysis integrating 10 single-cell datasets of sympathetic ganglia using Seurat v3 CCA-anchor-based integration.
* Whole Mouse Brain: a standard atlas dataset of the adult mouse brain, generated by the Allen Brain Atlas and accessed programatically.
